name: tsrs-lint-vue-test-project
description: What a project provides to tsrs-lint to lint .vue files, for the tests of the command (npm/tsrs/test/tsrs/lint-*.test.ts): the parsers, the SFC compiler and Oxlint. Not published; nothing here is a dependency of the tsrs package. It is apart from the npm tooling package because @typescript-eslint/parser needs the TypeScript 6 API as `typescript`, which there is the TypeScript 7 build compiler.
